items.title: Show HN: StatLite – Lightweight dashboard for application monitoring
items.contentSnippet:
Single Go binary (~15 MB RAM), compact SQLite-based storage with configurable retention. Ideal for self-hosted app monitoring. No Prometheus/Grafana stack required.
Shows app and DB health, charts for latency, http status codes, native support for Micrometer-based frameworks like Spring Boot/Micronaut/Quarkus. Simple app integration recipes for Django, Express, FastAPI, Go/Gin and others.
Live demo: https://pvrlabs.xyz/statlite/demo.html

items.title: From Compliance to Contribution: What Happens When Students Do Work That Matters
items.contentSnippet:
What if the most important outcome of a learning experience was not a credential but a shift in how a young person sees themselves? Nikki Stancampiano and Reem Al-Adhami share how the PAST Foundation's work-based learning program moved students from compliance to contribution, and from career exposure to genuine identity formation. This piece is essential reading for leaders designing learning experiences that build agency, belonging, and purpose alongside academic skills.
